subject: Installing a C++ compiler to install R-Stan on Mac OS X Yosemite

messages.author: 90269c7d7f4c563f
messages.subject: Installing a C++ compiler to install R-Stan on Mac OS X Yosemite
parts:
Dear D-RUG,

Not exactly related to R, although I need it ultimately for an R package, I have been trying to install a C++ compiler on my new computer, but keep receiving the following error when trying to install XCode:

The product distribution file could not be verified. It may be damaged or was not signed.

Does anyone know of any other programs I might try, or if this problem is easy to get around?

Thanks,
Rei Scampavia

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Installing a C++ compiler to install R-Stan on Mac OS X Yosemite
parts:
Hmm well it's likely a problem with the installation itself, then.  But just in case, try:

  • Open App Store application.
  • In the menu select "Store" > "Check for Unfinished Downloads ..."
  • Install the update
Otherwise, there seems to be a solution here: https://discussions.apple.com/thread/2710174?start=30&tstart=0
